document.name: Community Connection — Family Enrichment Center
document.description:
Community Connection is a Family Enrichment Center serving Southeast Queens families. The official site describes it as a safe space for community, connection, creativity, culture, and empowerment, and says families can use the center for free events for the entire family, resources, and community-led support. Forestdale's program page says the center was co-created with neighbors and that weekly events and offerings are shaped with the community.

Official contact details published by the organization and ACS include 203-12 Linden Boulevard, Jamaica, NY 11412, phone 347-308-7762, and Instagram @communityconnection.fec.

Sources: https://www.communityconnectionfec.org/ https://www.nyc.gov/site/acs/about/fec.page https://www.forestdaleinc.org/community-connection-fec
